en: Welcome to the Masters' Hall! A master of every species waits here for a Trainer who has raised one of their own.
Will you put one of your Pokémon forward?
Please choose the Pokémon you'll put forward.
{chosen}! The {master} will see you now. Please step onto the mark.
You already hold the title of {master}. The master will gladly battle you again, but the title is yours already.
So this is your {chosen}. Every one of its kind I've met has taught me something. Let's see what yours knows.
Not this time. Raise {chosen} a little more, and the two of you come back to me.
Well battled. {chosen} has a Trainer who understands it, and that is what a master looks for.
{player} holds the title of {master}! Titles held: {number}.
Please come again. The masters are always here.
Choose one of your Pokémon, and the master of its species battles it, one on one. Nothing may be used from the Bag.
Your own Pokémon battles, so what it learns here stays with it. There's no prize money, only the title.
Win, and the title of that species' master is yours. Lose, and you may try again whenever you like.
The receptionist will ask which of your Pokémon you'll put forward. I am the master of whichever it is.
